{"subject":"Congrats on Pulley's $41M Series B","body":"Hi Michael,

Congratulations on Pulley's $41M Series B four days ago. I also saw you've posted an Enterprise SDR Manager role and two Enterprise Account Executive openings, one with a 2027 start.

With new sellers coming, a pipeline process helps them get going faster. Quillpath reads your CRM every night, flags stalled deals (no activity, missing next step, slipped close date), and gives each rep a short list of next actions per deal. It also writes a weekly pipeline and forecast summary you can forward upward.

Setup takes about 15 minutes on top of HubSpot or Salesforce, with nothing to migrate. Would you be open to a free 14-day pilot on your real pipeline?","missing":["Which CRM Pulley uses (HubSpot or Salesforce)","Whether Pulley has a RevOps person or an existing pipeline review process","Any detail on what Pulley's board expects for forecasting"]}
